notes:
**Update the app and the server together** — an older server tells the app nothing of what a player may change, and the editor then holds nothing back.

**New**
- The editor offers a player only what they may change: the other parts and values stand as they read, dimmed, and the code view stays read-only.
- A value a player may set on their own — Owner or Acquired on an item — is there for them before it holds anything.
- D&D 5e template: players may make items of every kind; homebrew items are theirs to change, the books' items stay the GM's.

**Fixed**
- A save that fails is no longer tried again and again; its warning no longer flickers.
- A package taken in anew keeps the pictures its articles name when one of them could not come along, and counts as no change.
- A world without any picture is backed up too — on a server such a world was never backed up.
